fact: Cape Verde launched the development of a national Artificial Intelligence Strategy at a kick-off meeting (reported held 28 April 2026) with government officials, external consultants and EU representatives; the strategy is still to be written.

Ecofin Agency reports Cape Verde launched the process to develop a dedicated AI strategy at a meeting on 28 April 2026 led by Digital Economy Minister Olavo Correia with consultants present; no timeline given.
